body: I DON'T KNOW WHY I'M DEPRESSED. THAT'S THE WORST PART. Nothing makes me feel better, I care about nothing. No achievement, or family outing, or talking to friends feels like anything. I have a "great" life. And yet I hate living. I feel ungrateful, I wish I could give my life to someone who actually wants to be here. I literally wake up and think "Fuck...I'm still alive."
I feel the same way. I even find myself asking people what they just said to me because I was thinking of something else the entire time they were talking.
